name: Nicolas S. Zeppos College

decisions: Metro has 5 footprints here where OSM has one; compared against their union, OSM kept as one building (roof parts split it)
OSM and Metro differ (corner p95 8.13 m); OSM is as close or closer to the LiDAR edge (0.76 vs 0.80 m): OSM used
LiDAR edge adjustment produced an invalid outline: kept the outline so far

material_rule: walls and vertical roof steps brick_red (guess); roof faces flatter than 6 deg roof_flat, steeper roof_slate unless the Metro 2026 ortho color is clearly green (roof_copper) or orange-red (roof_tile); base concrete

collider.kind: one non-convex static triangle mesh (LoD2 shell without base cap)

accuracy.reason: P1 (curved, 1031 m2): eave -0.47 m, ridge -0.09 m, 98% of roof points within 0.5 m; P4 (curved, 115 m2): eave -0.22 m, ridge -0.05 m, 100% of roof points within 0.5 m; P21 (curved, 9 m2): eave -0.36 m, ridge +0.10 m, 90% of roof points within 0.5 m; ... 1 more parts over 0.2 m

footprint.reference: osm outline; LiDAR edge for moved corners
